pages.name: Nichnytsia
pages.text: Very like a mavka. Perhaps the energy of this place changed her?

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: She wanders the forest and leaves nearly everyone alone. But once she sees you she $(thing)throws potions$(): poisoning and weakening.$(br2)Keep away if you have nothing to answer with.

pages.title: How to make peace
pages.text: $(#2E7D4F)A gift with a soul:$() offer a $(item)Crystallized Soul$(). The Nichnytsia accepts and gives a helpful potion.$(br2)The peace lasts $(thing)five minutes$(). More: $(l:general/affection)Favour of Creatures$(/l).
